summary: Backend-only SQLite/D1 Drizzle schema authority, consumed by api-cf, Web backend queries and Drizzle Kit. No browser or domain dependency on this package.

key_files.src/auth.ts: Single Better Auth users/sessions/accounts/verifications table definitions and bidirectional ORM relations. Column SQL foreign keys are absent; relation fields/references remain query metadata.
key_files.src/app.ts: Shared cloud control-plane Project, tenant, token, provider, legacy installed-record and Asset/index tables. Project Loro and local SQLite authority are not moved here.
key_files.src/broker.ts: API-only capability broker audit table, preserving its existing columns and indexes.
key_files.src/runtime.ts: Web backend runtime, runtime token/session, chat message and agent member index tables; not a replacement local Host state store.
key_files.src/schema.test.ts: Generates actual Drizzle Kit DDL, executes it in SQLite with foreign_keys enabled, exercises cross-auth-ID writes and both directions of Better Auth relation queries.

architecture_notes: Narrow source exports auth/app/broker/runtime are consumed directly by TypeScript-aware Node/Worker bundlers and Drizzle Kit. There is no broad root export or pre-build requirement.

Existing API and Web schema files are compatibility export profiles: API includes app+broker, Web includes app+runtime. Their auth paths all re-export auth. Preserve each profile so migration discovery does not silently add or drop a backend-specific table.
Never add column .references() or foreignKey definitions. Do not confuse ORM relations({ fields, references }) with SQL constraints.

Historical migration SQL and deployed tables are unchanged. Removing source SQL foreign keys only changes future schema generation; existing deployed constraints require a separately reviewed migration if needed.
Only backend apps depend on this package. Do not import Drizzle or these tables into shared-types, GUI or browser domain contracts.
